images.caption: w:NEXRAD Radar image of the May 4, 2007 Greensburg EF5 tornado (seen as a purple pyramid). The tornado directly impacted Greensburg, Kansas, leaving twelve dead. Afterwards, the progression shows the supercell recycling to form the extremely large Trousdale and Macksville EF3 tornadoes. This is viewed using the reflectivity panel.
images.alt: w:NEXRAD Radar image of the May 4, 2007 Greensburg EF5 tornado (seen as a purple pyramid). The tornado directly impacted Greensburg, Kansas, leaving twelve dead. Afterwards, the progression shows the supercell recycling to form the extremely large Trousdale and Macksville EF3 tornadoes. This is viewed using the reflectivity panel.
images.artist: National Weather Service (NWS), Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), and United States Air Force (USAF)
